newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends much weaker in erratic trade.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends much weaker in erratic trade.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed significantly weaker at C$1.3445 (US$0.7438) from Wednesday's close at C$1.3375 (US$0.7477) in erratic trading, dealers said.* They said wdespread interest to take profits after a two-week rally in the currency pulled the Canadian dollar weaker. * The Bank of Canada intervened to buy Canadian dollars at C$1.3450.
The Bank of Canada intervened in late afternoon trading, buying Canadian dollars for U.S. dollars at around the C$1.3450 (US$0.7435) level, dealers said.
They said the intervention did not come as a surprise and was considered light.
In economic news, Statistics Canada reported early on Thursday that Canada's consumer price index remained unchanged in December and rose 2.2 percent on the year.
The numbers were in line with analysts' expectations and did not have much of an effect on the Canadian dollar, traders said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar sank to 1.2116 marks from Wednesday's close of 1.2261 marks and dropped to 88.64 yen from Wednesday's 88.96 yen.
